title: 藏经阁残简 第十三章 道基无瑕文脉重生藏经阁残简 第十四章 罚期将尽管事再来
slug: 残简道藏我靠修复古籍证道
content_zh:
陆明远的脚步声彻底消失在阁楼山道尽头。
风停尘静，整座顶层阁楼重归寂静。
方才面对陆明远时的麻木、顺从、庸碌伪装，一层层从沈砚眼底褪去。
取而代之的，是澄澈冰冷的清明，与沉淀了整整三年的深敛锋芒。
阁楼空寂，天光落身。
沈砚立身万卷残简之间，心神彻底沉定。
《破妄文章》缓缓收束流转，方才勘破的所有阴谋、黑暗、域外侵染，尽数沉淀于心。
从前迷雾重重的过往，此刻已然条条清晰。
陆明远非单纯妒恨。
周长老非秉公惩戒。
三年碎基之祸，是域外暗力布局、借宗门之手斩灭人族文道幼苗的阴毒算计。
玄洲文脉凋零，仙门日渐腐朽。
不是天道自然兴衰，是人为暗中断道！
“斩我道基，灭我机缘，腐我宗门文脉……”
沈砚低声轻语，声音冷如寒玉。
旧怨新危，尽数了然。
但他并未躁动，亦无暴怒。
三年尘埃蛰伏，早已养出他泰山崩于前而色不变的沉稳心境。
怒火无用，恨意无用。
唯有实力，可破虚妄，可清算仇怨，可逆转文脉颓势。

沈砚移步阁楼中央，盘膝静坐。
两日禁足守阁，他搜刮整座西阁遗落的所有残简，修复无数失传古法、文道秘章，海量道韵积攒丹田，早已将道基修复推至最后关头。
只差最后一步圆满。
双目轻阖，心神归一。
残简道藏之力悄然运转。
丹田之内，那道破碎三年、蛛网遍布的先天道基，此刻被层层上古精纯文道韵包裹、滋养、熨帖。
滋滋——
细微道音在体内轻鸣。
无数细微裂痕飞速愈合、收拢、消弭。
原本黯淡破损的道基，被海量失传文脉彻底淬炼重塑。
褪去陈旧瑕疵，洗尽三年伤痕。
一寸寸，变得莹白、通透、无瑕。
以往宗门修士修复道基，只求愈合破损、恢复修为。
而沈砚，以万卷残简道韵重塑根基。
他的道基，不再是寻常先天道基。
历经破败、浴文重生、承载上古万道，品质早已超脱凡俗！
嗡——
丹田轰鸣，灵气彻体。
最后一丝残缺彻底补全。
道基，彻底圆满！

三年废身，彻底翻盘。
不止复原巅峰，更胜往昔十倍！
content_en:
Lu Mingyuan's footsteps completely disappeared at the end of the attic mountain path.
The wind stopped and the dust fell silent, and the entire top floor attic returned to silence.
The numbness, resignation, and mediocre pretense when facing Lu Mingyuan just faded away from Shen Yan's eyes.
Instead, there is a clear and cold clarity, and a deep edge that has accumulated for three years.
The attic is empty and the sky is falling.
Shen Yan stood among thousands of scraps of scraps, his mind completely calm.
"Articles on Destruction of Illusions" slowly gathered and circulated, and all the conspiracies, darkness, and extraterritorial contamination that had just been uncovered settled in my heart.
The past that was once so foggy is now clear.
Lu Ming was far from simply jealous.
Elder Zhou punished him impartially.
The calamity of three years of broken foundations was a sinister plan by secret forces from outside the region to use the hands of the sect to kill the seedlings of human civilization.
The cultural context of Xuanzhou has withered, and the Immortal Sect is gradually decaying.
It’s not the natural rise and fall of heaven’s way, it’s man-made secret interruption!
"Kill my Dao foundation, destroy my opportunities, corrupt my sect's cultural heritage..."
Shen Yan whispered softly, his voice as cold as cold jade.
Old grievances and new dangers are all clear.
But he was neither restless nor furious.
Three years of dormancy in the dust had already developed in him a calm state of mind that would remain unchanged despite the collapse of the mountain.
Anger is useless, hate is useless.
Only strength can break through illusions, settle grievances, and reverse the decline of a cultural context.
Shen Yan moved to the center of the attic and sat cross-legged in silence.
After being banned from guarding the pavilion for two days, he searched for all the remaining fragments of the entire west pavilion, repaired countless lost ancient laws, literary and Taoist secrets, and accumulated a large amount of Taoist rhymes in the Dantian. He had already pushed the restoration of the Taoist foundation to the last moment.
Just the last step to perfection.
The eyes are lightly closed and the mind is unified.
The power of Daozang on the broken bamboo slips is quietly operating.
Within the dantian, the innate Tao foundation that had been broken for three years and covered with cobwebs was now wrapped, nourished, and plastered by layers of ancient pure literary and Taoist rhymes.
Sizzling——
The subtle sound of the Tao whispers softly in the body.
Countless tiny cracks quickly healed, closed, and disappeared.
The original dark and damaged Taoist foundation was completely tempered and reshaped by the massive lost cultural context.
Fade away old blemishes and wash away three-year scars.
Inch by inch, it becomes white, transparent and flawless.
In the past, sect monks repaired the Taoist foundation just to heal the damage and restore their cultivation.
And Shen Yan rebuilt the foundation with the Taoist rhyme of thousands of scraps of scraps.
His Dao foundation is no longer the ordinary innate Dao foundation.
After being ruined and reborn, it has carried thousands of ancient principles, and its quality has already transcended the ordinary world!
Buzz——
The Dantian roars and spiritual energy penetrates the body.
The last bit of imperfection was completely completed.
Daoji, complete consummation!
After three years of ruin, he made a complete comeback.
Not only restored to the peak, but ten times better than before!
